title: Bound live console route smoke and expose live adapter failures
description: After the CLI compile repair, fixture console smoke and fixture browser smoke passed, but pnpm console:smoke -- --mode live did not complete after more than 90 seconds and had to be interrupted. Live route checks should not hang operator workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm console:smoke -- --mode live completes within an explicit timeout on this workspace.
When live CLI reads fail or time out, /api/state and rendered routes expose an actionable warning/error instead of silently looking like healthy fixture data.
Tests cover a slow or failing live runner and assert bounded failure behavior.
closedReason: Live console smoke is bounded, reports route timings, and no longer hangs
